title: SC-02 independent asset visual-quality review, second quality repair pass

reviewer.method: Read the original brief; individually inspected all 30 current thumbnails and all 34 larger detail/open PNGs before consulting current counters. Compared images with the preserved pass2 observations. No implementation source inspected and no builder repair rationale used as acceptance evidence.

objective: A premium production-quality spatial creative library; recognizable primitive placeholders alone do not satisfy the mandatory geometry/material standard.

sourceIdentity.limitation: Source-bound evidence snapshots/hashes identify the reviewed packet; this is not a frozen committed product candidate.

overall.rationale: Eight of eleven previous quality blockers are resolved with visible modeling/material/artwork improvements. The note, vase and banner still have concrete visible defects; the larger packet also reveals an unfinished lantern-loop connection. Twenty-six assets pass a bounded review of these supplied views, which is an asset-form/material observation rather than certification of all mandatory production behavior or the premium library/product journey as a whole.

priorFindings.evidence: See per-asset observations and hashed larger views.
Note has an abrupt upright triangle; vase decoration is fragmented despite smooth profile; banner has a notch but still rigid corrugated cloth.

findings.observation: Four assets have specific visible construction/material defects. See per-asset findings for exact observations and bounded repairs.
findings.requiredRepair: Repair these concrete defects and re-render matching views. Preserve the current evidence and obtain a final bounded independent re-review.

findings.observation: This packet contains exported-GLB pipeline renders only. Actual Studio catalog use, composition, lighting/effects interaction, authoring, save/reload and normal-viewport scenes are outside this review.
findings.requiredEvidence: Separate actual application capture and journey review; do not substitute pipeline stills or metadata.

dimensions.recognizability: All thirty requested categories are represented; the folded-note form remains specifically weak.
dimensions.detailedGeometry: Material progress is visible in swept feet, padding, fitted puzzle tiles, cloth gathering, paper artwork and rug construction. Four remaining concrete issues prevent complete-catalog acceptance.
dimensions.proportions: Broad scale relationships look plausible in isolated views. The open drawer, door, chest and sign views show actual alternative geometry states; real-world/editor placement and behavioral pivots remain unverified.
dimensions.materialResponse: Metal highlights, transparent enclosure, wood grain, upholstery weave, paper texture and rug textile response are now visible. The style remains simplified with regular repeated wood grain; this is not a demand for photorealism. The vase decoration is a confirmed finish problem.
dimensions.normals: No gross missing/inverted face confirmed. Static views under one lighting setup do not establish complete normal/tangent or backface correctness.
dimensions.consistency: Common dark background and stylized color/material language are coherent. Larger views resolve many small-prop detail gaps.
dimensions.distinctiveness: Thirty meaningfully different requested forms are present; map/chart now have different artwork and the two chests have distinct lid construction. Counts are not treated as quality proof.
dimensions.premiumStandard: Supported for recognizability and significantly improved authored construction at bounded view level; not established for the whole production catalog while four defects and all product/behavior acceptance obligations remain.

capabilityStatus.exportedPipeline: VISIBLE: all 64 supplied images inspected; counters support visibility but are not quality authority
capabilityStatus.openStates: Door, drawer, articulated chest and wall sign alternate states visually inspected; no interaction/playback correctness claimed
capabilityStatus.performance: OBSERVATION_ONLY: software WebGL loadAndRenderMs across supplied views ranges about 42.4 to 290.9 ms; no representative editor/device frame or cleanup qualification
capabilityStatus.provenance: MANIFEST_DECLARED_ONLY: AI-assisted original geometry, proprietary license, owner authorization required, not published; rights/source provenance not audited in this visual task

limitations: PASS_AT_SUPPLIED_VIEWS is a bounded positive judgment of rendered form/material in the supplied stills. It is not a proxy for all mandatory model behavior, target performance, actual product visual completion or owner acceptance.
The larger images use another angle at 960 x 640, not a full turntable, all lighting conditions or unrestricted close inspection. Backside/hidden-surface quality remains incompletely observed.
Minor finishing limitations are recorded separately from the four confirmed blockers. No implementation source was inspected to invent or diagnose a cause.
Static open-state renders establish visible alternate geometry only; they cannot establish usable pivots, animation, cancellation, save/reload, collision or physical support.
All earlier reviews and their exact images remain preserved. No implementation files were edited by this reviewer.
